title: Chapter 158 - 158 Misunderstanding; Write A Thesis!

Chapter 158 - 158 Misunderstanding; Write A Thesis!

Chapter 158 - 158 Misunderstanding; Write a Thesis!

158 Misunderstanding; Write a Thesis!

Seeing this…

Senior Lu, Senior Fan, and Qin Yuxuan were all puzzled.

“Professor Feng, is there a misunderstanding?” Qin Yuxuan asked. “Did you get the wrong person?”

Professor Feng’s actions were really too big.

It was as if Lin Fan was someone who had done something bad.

However, Qin Yuxuan believed in Lin Fan’s character.

“Professor Feng, you must have misunderstood,” Senior Lu chimed in.

After all, Lin Fan was someone who could spend close to 100 million yuan to buy an office in less than ten minutes.

He was no average person.

How could he do something bad?

“Professor Feng, let’s sit down and talk slowly,” said Senior Fan.

“What misunderstanding?!” Professor Feng shouted. “Yesterday, he derived the economics formula in front of me!

“Just a little bit more and it could’ve formed an economic formula and theorem!

“We can’t let him go!”

Qin Yuxuan, Senior Lu, and Senior Fan were all stunned.

They all saw the message sent by Professor Feng.

A super genius had appeared at Modu University!

He had deduced and summarized a formula that was enough to make economics take a big step forward!

Although they had not seen this person with their own eyes, they were also filled with admiration for this person.

In the end…

This person was Lin Fan?

Not only was Lin Fan rich, but he was also smart!

Heavens!

What kind of immortal was this?

Then, Qin Yuxuan blushed.

She suddenly remembered Professor Feng saying that the male student had stopped deducing after receiving a call from his girlfriend and left immediately.

Therefore, Professor Feng said that the woman was a disaster to the country and its people.

No!

Professor Feng was not the only one who thought so.

She seemed to think so too.

In the end…

She was this woman who brought disaster to the country and its people?

Lin Fan coughed lightly and said, “Professor Feng, don’t worry. I won’t leave.”

However, Professor Feng had no intention of letting go.

Yesterday, because she did not stop Lin Fan, she regretted it the entire night.

Today, they finally met again. She would never let such a thing happen again!

“Professor Feng, why don’t we sit down first?” Lin Fan pointed at Qin Yuxuan, “Look… My girlfriend is here. I won’t leave again.”

“What? You’re that woman who brought disaster to the country and its people?” Professor Feng shouted.

Qin Yuxuan’s pretty face instantly turned red as she lowered her head silently.

At this point…

Professor Feng slowly put down Lin Fan’s arm and asked, “What’s your name?”

“My name is Lin Fan,” Lin Fan answered honestly.

Yesterday, Lin Fan was not too polite to her.

After all, she was just a stranger.

Today was different.

Today, Lin Fan knew that she was a teacher who took good care of Qin Yuxuan.

Therefore, he had to show respect.

“Lin Fan, it’s such a pity that you left yesterday…

“If you had continued to derive it, it would very likely become an economic formula or theorem! I’m afraid I don’t know when you’ll be able to complete it next time.” Professor Feng sighed, her face full of regret.

“Anytime,” Lin Fan said casually.

He was not speaking nonsense.

That was because the specific derivation formula had been imprinted in his mind when he triggered the flash of inspiration. It was impossible for him to forget it.

“Really?” Professor Feng shouted excitedly.

Lin Fan nodded his head.

Seeing this…

Professor Feng hurriedly took out a notebook and a ballpoint pen from her bag.

She said in a tone full of anticipation, “Lin Fan, quickly write down the derivation and the final formula for me.”

Lin Fan thought that since the dishes had not been served yet and he had nothing to do anyway, he might as well do it.

Therefore, he took the pen and paper and wrote quickly.

Immediately, the sound of a ballpoint pen tapping on the notebook rang out.

At the same time, a series of elegant and flowing characters quickly appeared in the notebook.

Qin Yuxuan, who was sitting at the side, looked at Lin Fan’s serious expression as he wrote the calculations. She was entranced.

In the past, when she was in high school, Lin Fan was very hardworking and serious.

The reason why Qin Yuxuan liked Lin Fan…

On one hand, Lin Fan was indeed handsome. On the other hand, he was serious.

That was because a serious man could exude a unique charm.

At this moment, in Qin Yuxuan’s eyes, Lin Fan was exuding his charm to the extreme, causing her heart to race.

If it was not for Professor Feng and the others, Qin Yuxuan would have thrown herself into Lin Fan’s arms.

Lin Fan’s writing speed was very fast. In just a few minutes, two pages of the notebook were filled with neat calculations.

Soon, the third page was finished.

Lin Fan put down his pen and paper.

After the deduction, the economic theorem and formula appeared!

“Alright, alright! That’s great!” Professor Feng shouted excitedly, her entire face full of smiles.

Then, she hugged the book tightly in her arms like a treasure.

Senior Fan could not help but ask, “Professor Feng, is the formula correct?”

Her studies were not bad.

However, Lin Fan’s calculations were too complicated. She could not understand them at all.

“This requires detailed verification!” Professor Feng said. “However, even if the conclusion is wrong, it’ll still greatly promote the development of economics!

“And if it’s correct…”

At this point, Professor Feng’s face became even more excited.

She seemed to have already seen the grand scene after the formula was proven to be correct.

Then, Professor Feng said, “Lin Fan, spend more time and write a complete economics thesis on the derivation of the formula. I’ll help you revise it and submit it to Ecta.”

Lin Fan waved his hand, “Let Yuxuan write it. I’ll tell her the detailed process.”

Professor Feng looked deeply at Lin Fan, her face revealing a look of shock that was hard to hide.

Having her write the thesis was equivalent to giving away half of the credit for free.

After all, this was half the result that could make the entire field of economics take a big step forward. It might even win them the Nobel Prize in Economics. They would leave a mark on history!

Even a married couple would not be so generous.

Moreover, they were just a couple!

“Lin Fan, you should write it. I didn’t even participate in this deduction process,” Qin Yuxuan said.

Obviously, she understood what it meant to write a thesis.

Lin Fan said, “I’ve never studied economics. I’ve never even written a thesis before. How could I write such things? Yuxuan, don’t decline.”

“Uhh… Alright then.” Qin Yuxuan hesitated for a moment before answering.

However, she had already decided that even if she had to write the thesis herself, she would leave all the glory to Lin Fan.
